Sandbox_VehicleStorageCapacity_TrunkPerc: Capacity of trunks, truck beds, van cargo areas, roof racks, side boxes and toolboxes, as a percent of normal. 100 is the game's value and 200 doubles it. A container never holds more than 1000, the game's limit. Applies to vehicles from any mod, including KI5.
Sandbox_VehicleStorageCapacity_SeatPerce: Capacity of every seat, bed and stretcher in vehicles, trailers and campers, as a percent of normal. The game still holds a quarter as much while someone sits there.
Sandbox_VehicleStorageCapacity_GloveBoxP: Capacity of glove boxes and center consoles, as a percent of normal.
Sandbox_VehicleStorageCapacity_TrailerPe: Capacity of trailer beds, cargo boxes and camper cabinets, as a percent of normal. Seats and beds inside campers use the seat setting instead.
